en-US.description: A simple-to-use AI photo retouching tool for one-click RAW development, skin smoothing, and liquify.
en-US.longDescription:
PixCake is an easy-to-use AI photo retouching tool: drag in a picture and it performs intelligent RAW development and color grading, skin smoothing, and full-body liquify in one click.
It is built for batch retouching of portrait and studio photography, turning "one second for a first pass, three seconds for a fine pass" into a routine workflow. Free to use with an optional in-app VIP subscription.

zh-CN.description: 简单易用的 AI 修图工具，拖入图片即可一键智能 Raw 转档调色、一键磨皮全身液化。
zh-CN.longDescription:
像素蛋糕是一款简单易用的 AI 修图工具，只需要拖入图片，即可实现一键智能 Raw 转档调色，一键磨皮全身液化，轻松实现"一秒初修，三秒精修"的批量修图操作。
它面向人像和影楼摄影的批量精修场景，软件可免费使用，并提供可选的应用内 VIP 订阅。
